findings.message: Terminology bank departures on the unit's five core terms. The Urdu uses تعلیمی اسلوب (15x) for Learning Style, سست سیکھنے والا (18x) for Slow Learner, خاص صلاحیت والا (20x) for Gifted Learner, شمولی تعلیم (10x) for Inclusive Education and انفرادی فرق (7x) for Individual Differences; terminology.csv banks طرزِ تعلم, کمزور متعلم, ذہین متعلم, شمولیتی تعلیم and انفرادی اختلافات (rows 15, 50, 51, 52, 90). The unit contradicts itself: its concept graph (specs/content/efmp-301/concepts/unit-07.md) and its own figure labels use the banked forms (fig-U7-1 title طرزِ تعلم; fig-U7-3/fig-U7-4 کمزور متعلم / ذہین متعلم), and the English teacher notes' banked-terms line (unit-teacher-notes.mdx:80-82) names them. index.mdx key_terms declares انفرادی فرق / سست سیکھنے والا / شمولی تعلیم and will fail check:pipeline-gate FR-016c the moment translation_status flips to reviewed. Units 5 and 6 were repaired to the bank after their G5 round 1, so the course practice is conform-or-rule. Per the style guide the owner resolves translator-vs-bank conflicts: either conform the Urdu to the bank, or record an owner ruling and update the bank first (note that the banked کمزور متعلم "weak learner" itself sits oddly with this unit's slow-≠-weak teaching, which is exactly why it needs an explicit owner decision rather than a silent translator choice).
